pages.title: Gru Facing Vector and His Squid Launcher Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gru facing Vector and his squid launcher, with Gru's striped scarf, Vector's glasses, and a squid emerging from the weapon. Long coat panels and tracksuit sections provide broad coloring spaces, while the launcher's rings and tiled ground add smaller details.

pages.title: Gru Spraying Antidote Jelly at an Evil Minion Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru sprays antidote jelly at an evil Minion in this printable coloring page, aiming a large canister gun toward the creature's wild hair and goggles. The Minion's jagged teeth and raised hands contrast with Gru's steady stance. Scarf stripes, overall straps, and droplets divide the coloring sheet into smaller sections.

pages.title: Gru Playing Tennis with Perry Prescott Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gru playing tennis with Perry Prescott, holding his racket back as a ball travels above the court's central net. Both characters wear shorts and sports shoes. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing areas with fine racket strings, net squares, and the fence behind Perry.

pages.title: Gru Protecting Baby Gru Jr. From the Honey Badger Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru protects baby Gru Jr. from a honey badger in this printable coloring page, cradling the child while extending an open hand toward the animal. The badger crouches near his feet with its teeth showing. Locker panels, floor tiles, and Gru's striped scarf add detail around the central figures.

pages.title: Gru Arresting Maxime at Their Villain School Reunion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gru arresting Maxime at their villain school reunion, fastening handcuffs while Maxime looks back through round glasses beneath his tall hairstyle. A shaggy coat frames Maxime's suit. Balloons, triangular bunting, and decorated tables surround the pair, adding smaller party details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Gru and Maxime Singing at the Prison Concert Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru and Maxime sing at a prison concert in this printable coloring page, holding microphones in striped uniforms while Minions raise their hands below the stage. Maxime points upward beneath a row of spotlights. The coloring sheet includes musical notes, prison bars, and broad stripes across the singers' clothing.

pages.title: Young Gru at His Vicious 6 Interview Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Gru at his Vicious 6 interview, clasping his hands near his scarf while two seated villains watch from behind a desk. His side-parted hair and worried eyebrows define his expression. Coat buttons, scarf bands, and the interviewers' clothing create varied sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Gru Escaping the Vicious 6 with the Zodiac Stone Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Gru escapes the Vicious 6 with the Zodiac Stone in this printable coloring page, running along a street while a villain pursues him from behind. He grips the round patterned stone beside his striped scarf. Swept hair, bent legs, and the long coat emphasize movement on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Gru Reacting to Otto's Pet Rock Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures young Gru reacting to Otto's pet rock, raising his hands as the smiling Minion presents the small spotted stone in a basement. Otto's braces, goggles, and overall pocket provide compact details. Pipes, a hanging lamp, and stairs form the background of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Minions Gru Watching On Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru watches from an arched bridge in this printable coloring page, extending one arm beside four Minions as a castle rises beyond the railing under rounded clouds. The bridge's large arches and open sky provide broad coloring areas, with smaller sections along the railing, goggles, and distant castle towers.

pages.title: Minions Gru Exploring By Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gru exploring beside a lake with three Minions, their figures reflected in the water beneath a large sun with long rays. Rounded hills and sparse trees frame the group. The coloring sheet pairs open sky and water with small goggle rings, overall pockets, and grass tufts.

pages.title: Minions Gru Watching By Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru watches beside a lake with three Minions in this printable coloring page, standing behind two back-facing companions while another looks up through round goggles. A curved shoreline, rolling hills, and tall narrow trees surround the group. Wide open spaces across the sky and lake balance the smaller clothing details.

pages.title: Minions Gru Balancing In Lava Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru balances above a lava area in this printable coloring page, holding a long pole while two Minions stand on smaller rocks beside him. Stacked stones, bubbling rings, flying bananas, and a crescent moon give the coloring sheet several distinct shapes around the central balancing pose.

pages.title: Minions Gru Looking Around At Fishing Spot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gru looking around a fishing spot from behind a large boulder while two Minions hold rods beside a small pond. Lily pads and circular ripples mark the water, with rounded hills, clouds, and a leafy tree filling the surrounding landscape.

pages.title: Minions Gru Reaching On Road Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru reaches toward four Minions on a curving road in this printable coloring page, leaning forward with one hand extended above the small group. His long striped scarf and coat add narrow sections, while the road, rounded clouds, and open sky offer broad spaces to color.

pages.title: Minions Gru Walking Slowly In Snowy Field Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Gru walking slowly through a snowy field with five Minions, several wearing knitted hats beneath snow-covered evergreen trees on distant hills. Gru's long coat forms a large open area, while scarf stripes, hat bands, goggles, and scattered snow contours add smaller details.

pages.title: Minions Gru Sitting On Lava Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru sits on a lava platform with two Minions in this printable coloring page, resting his hands beside him while one companion holds a small guitar. Circular rock markings, distant volcanoes, and rounded clouds surround the trio, combining broad cliff surfaces with compact clothing and instrument details.

pages.title: Minions Gru Running In Grassy Field Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gru running through a grassy field with four Minions, his striped scarf streaming sideways as the group lifts its arms and feet. Grass tufts dot the foreground beneath a sun and rounded clouds, leaving generous open areas around the moving characters.

pages.title: Minions Gru Exploring In Hallway Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru explores a long hallway with two Minions in this printable coloring page, looking toward arched doorways as square wall lamps repeat along the corridor. Receding floor tiles define the space. The coloring sheet includes large wall areas alongside smaller goggle rings, scarf stripes, and coat buttons.

pages.title: Minions Gru Balancing By Water Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gru balancing beside water on a striped beach ball, extending both arms while three Minions perch above his head and shoulders. Bananas, a small flag, and a propeller cap add playful details, with gentle wave lines and a palm-covered island behind them.

pages.title: Minions Gru Running in Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Gru runs through a workshop with two Minions in this printable coloring page, passing a workbench covered with tools beneath shelves of bottles and a rocket model. Pipes, gears, and a control console provide smaller sections on the coloring sheet around the broad shapes of the characters' clothing.
